description:
## [1.71.0](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/compare/v1.70.0...v1.71.0) (2026-11-04)

### Bug Fixes

* **Clip Studio Paint - Unlock premium:** remove monthly drawing limit ([9910992](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/9910992461e1ef599bb1b91645199a2c8278e6d6))
* **Muviz Widgets - Fix weather:** show weather in weather widgets ([869b0e5](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/869b0e5002f70484864c3debf6fcb7e3fe708310))
* **Proton Mail - AMOLED dark theme:** turn sale screens black ([5fb7dc6](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/5fb7dc6326c6379c60c51b5618f064bd0d806e8d))
* **Quranify - Unlock premium:** load reciters and Home ([93c8aef](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/93c8aef136856488be1f6b794b1cb4bccd5560bc)), closes [#617](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/issues/617)
* **Realme Link - Bypass session expiry:** stop session timeout prompts ([550759c](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/550759c5bf2699fae444391727746648f40951f0)), closes [#611](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/issues/611)

### New Features

* **Duolingo - Disable dynamic app icon:** keep default launcher icon ([ca95381](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/ca9538157c9e3930cb5197ac9fb50eb7c8b1693a))
* **Duolingo - Enable debug mode:** show debug menu and button ([8d017cd](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/8d017cd3a9315bd0b806e4be2af72e77abe6d95a))
* **Duolingo - Unlimited RampUp time:** hold RampUp timer at one hour ([65f8661](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/65f8661464307268580a73aab27edbd52cf4cc44))
* **Duolingo - Unlock premium:** remove ads and energy limit ([03710cc](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/03710ccd9244571b1ff66898cdaca635e1027d19))
* **MuscleWiki - GmsCore support:** sign in with Google ([21c4b7e](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/21c4b7e97d8178524b50eb9925dce6105b89e5b4))
* **MuscleWiki - Unlock premium:** remove ads and launch paywall ([8b81d25](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/8b81d251cf23456418390eff61ef84a0e7175e22))
* **Patreon - Disable Quips and autoplay:** remove Quip cards ([4c3a060](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/4c3a060600c04d8b21b1c4e5b78dcb05ed1cb78a))
* **Patreon - Disable tracking:** stop analytics and crash reports ([0331292](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/03312928502b925cd36387b57368a8d585c26faa))
* **Patreon - Hide Home tab:** start on Memberships ([cc56408](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/cc564081ac570c53c913a4ddf74d3dad1ca90874))
* **Patreon - Hide navigation buttons:** remove selected bottom bar tabs ([dfc6e66](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/dfc6e6620c23a524fc4826a68a003b8f10619df7))
* **Patreon - Hide recommended creators:** remove recommended Home posts ([ef5fc8c](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/ef5fc8c6470e8f48719624d455ea3b10014448e3))
* **Patreon - Hide upgrade promotions:** remove upgrade banners ([f3b840e](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/f3b840ef1cb555b4c3854186b24343d3654488bc))
* **Patreon - Remove app prompts:** skip rating and update prompts ([e7f00aa](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/e7f00aaca948455ca38bf7b5f03505970b95a117))
* **Quranify - Unlock premium:** remove Free Premium challenge ([7505c35](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/7505c35b760edd74ef4e01e073b79d448f135a85))
* **Viber - GmsCore support:** sign in to Google Drive for backups ([a756d09](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/a756d091ef2eaa54abfbc6230605e5eed3f6a827)), closes [#620](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/issues/620)

### Updated App Support

* **Duolingo:** add support for `6.103.6` ([96f8fe7](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/96f8fe7f078445675bb30adb844647a5345700f9))
* **Glass Widgets:** add support for `1.0.2` ([27e5724](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/27e57241ff451a9115b7830e7cfe40382cdc08c5)), closes [#497](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/issues/497)
* **Quranify:** add support for `2.3.0` ([0ee0adf](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/0ee0adf4feff25690348a60e952b8b3d9988a139))

patches.name: Speed test
patches.description: Adds an internet speed test with download and upload charts and a test history.

patches.name: Tool options
patches.description: Adds ping protocol, TCP ping, probe delay, payload size, don't fragment and audible ping, traceroute and port scan delays, whois and RDAP servers, and DNS flags.

patches.name: Tools history
patches.description: Lists the hosts queried in Tools with their last options, and lets you star or delete them. Tapping an entry opens it in Tools.

patches.name: UPnP browser
patches.description: Lists the UPnP devices on the Wi-Fi network with their model, manufacturer, embedded devices and services.

patches.name: Visual traceroute
patches.description: Shows the hops of the current or last traceroute on an OpenStreetMap map. Map tiles load from tile.openstreetmap.org.

patches.name: Wi-Fi channel usage
patches.description: Adds a chart of how busy each Wi-Fi channel is, stacking the networks that share it.

patches.name: Wi-Fi network details
patches.description: Adds a details page for each network in the Signal list with its channel range, utilization, beamforming support, maximum speed and modulation.

patches.name: Background listening
patches.description: Keeps text-to-speech playing while the app is in the background or the screen is off.

patches.name: Colored quotes
patches.description: Adds a color picker for quotes and highlights each quote in its own color.

patches.name: Custom fonts
patches.description: Adds fonts from a folder you choose to the reading fonts.

patches.name: Dictionary section
patches.description: Adds the Dictionary section with all saved words to the main menu.

patches.name: Dictionary word colors
patches.description: Adds a color picker for dictionary words.

patches.name: Footnote speech
patches.description: Adds an option to read footnotes aloud during text-to-speech.

patches.name: Library full screen
patches.description: Adds the option to use full-screen mode in the library as well as while reading.

patches.name: Library view modes
patches.description: Adds the Full, Brief, Thumbnails and Grid views to book lists.

patches.name: Page thumbnails
patches.description: Adds the page thumbnails button to the reader for browsing all pages of a book.

patches.name: Quotes and notes section
patches.description: Adds a section to the main menu with the quotes, bookmarks and reviews from all books.

patches.name: Remove nags
patches.description: Removes the rate this app dialog, the promotional dialogs shown on startup and the Go to Premium buttons in the toolbar and its menu.

patches.name: Skip headers and footers
patches.description: Adds an option to skip headers, footers and page numbers during text-to-speech. Applies to PDF and DjVu documents.

patches.name: Speech rate slider
patches.description: Adds a text-to-speech speed slider from 0.1x to 4x, saved per voice.

patches.name: Unlock aCalendar+
patches.description: Unlocks public holidays, color schemes, business features and tasks, and removes ads.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Adds an option to hide banner, interstitial, app-open and rewarded ads.

patches.name: Hide share options
patches.description: Adds an option to hide the share buttons on the save screen and center the saved photo.

patches.name: Inspect AI requests
patches.description: Shows the network calls an AI tool makes, such as HTTP requests and Firebase uploads. Keeps a log of them.

patches.name: Show AI progress
patches.description: Shows the current stage of AI Remove and Enhance on their loading screens.

patches.name: Speed up AI tools
patches.description: Shortens the AI tool wait by polling for the result more often and uploading the photo in larger chunks.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Adds an option to unlock the pro tools, remove the export watermark and hide the upgrade prompts.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Removes ads and enables the floating widget, dynamic island, route editing and tab customization. Points, quests and rankings are not included.

patches.description: Replaces the dark theme background with pure black and can dim menus, bars and buttons.

patches.description: Changes the accent color. Choose a color in the patches menu.
